notes.title: Nominate us for Indie Game of The Year at the OTK VGAs
notes.content:
We’d like to thank everyone who’s supported us and left a review since we released the game in March. It’s game awards season and we’d like to ask our community to nominate us for Indie Game of the Year in the OTK Game Awards. In order to nominate us, go to [url=https://www.otkvga.com/nominate]https://www.otkvga.com/nominate[/url] and choose Indie Game of The Year for the award category. Don’t forget to link to our store page as well: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325060/Alpacalypse/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325060/Alpacalypse/[/url]

Happy Halloween from the Alpacalypse Dev Team!
